definitions.explanation: A real occurrence or case that illustrates a point or serves as evidence.

examples.japanese: {実例|じつれい}を{挙|あ}げて{説明|せつめい}してください。
examples.english: Please explain with an actual example.

examples.japanese: これは{成功|せいこう}した{実例|じつれい}の{一|ひと}つです。
examples.english: This is one example of a successful case.

examples.japanese: {具体的|ぐたいてき}な{実例|じつれい}がないと{理解|りかい}しにくい。
examples.english: It's hard to understand without concrete examples.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
・{実例|じつれい}を{挙|あ}げる (to give an example)
・{実例|じつれい}を{示|しめ}す (to show an example)
・{具体的|ぐたいてき}な{実例|じつれい} (concrete example)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{例|れい} - example (general term)
・{事例|じれい} - case, instance (often professional/legal)
・{実例|じつれい} - actual example (emphasizes it really happened)
・{例|たと}え - analogy, metaphor

{実例|じつれい} emphasizes that the example is a real occurrence, not hypothetical.

[Register: Neutral to Formal]
